prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (copy, hint, redesign), choose_path (copy, hint, new_screen), finish (incentive, layout), home (wait_info), and sign_in (copy, hint, layout, notification, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test.
finish new_screen changes have 2 tests agreeing that no clear effect was seen.
choose_path layout changes have 2 tests agreeing that no clear effect was seen.
home new_flow changes can be helpful since 1 test won, though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Most changes tested so far (18 out of 22 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated impact for most tests, but underestimated the size of major wins.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Desktop Playground Intro: Redesigns the final home_intro screen into a full bleed interactive desktop preview showcasing pet interactions and controls. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% (mean 5815s) and support received 3 emails about confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
1: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Hatching Status Updates: Displays live dynamic status updates and animated milestones during the pet assembly wait step. (why: Home wait step has median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s. Dynamic milestones keep users engaged during compilation.)
2: [sign_in, notification] Cloud Save Status Alert Banner: Adds a cloud persistence badge banner above sign-in options explicitly explaining account pet linking. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again on duplicate accounts.)
3: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Creation Assurance Copy: Updates adoption certificate hint text explaining that pet names and attributes can be changed later in desktop settings. (why: Support logged 3 issues regarding custom pet generation errors or worries about finalized details.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Selection Card View: Changes choose_path screen layout to two_column for side-by-side comparison of quick adopt versus custom adoption. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with an 8s median / 514s mean time. Side-by-side structural comparison reduces decision latency.)
